def test_get_closest_vowel():
    # Basic cases from problem spec
    assert get_closest_vowel("yogurt") == "u"
    assert get_closest_vowel("FULL") == "U"
    assert get_closest_vowel("quick") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("ab") == ""

    # Words shorter than 3
    assert get_closest_vowel("") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("a") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("ax") == ""

    # Vowel found between two consonants
    assert get_closest_vowel("cat") == "a"
    assert get_closest_vowel("bAc") == "A"
    assert get_closest_vowel("XaY") == "a"

    # Rightmost qualifying vowel wins
    assert get_closest_vowel("catDog") == "o"

    # Vowels adjacent to vowels do not qualify
    assert get_closest_vowel("AEIOU") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("baE") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("bEa") == ""

    # No vowel between consonants
    assert get_closest_vowel("apple") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("aXb#") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("xyz") == ""

    # Non-letter characters count as non-vowels
    assert get_closest_vowel("x1o3x") == "o"

    # Vowel at edge positions (index 0 or last) cannot qualify
    assert get_closest_vowel("aXe") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("Xab") == ""
